mapper.select: SELECT cp.*, f.address_sido, f.address_sigungu, f.address_street, f.address_details, f.farm_name, COALESCE(f.thumbnail_url, '/resources/img/carbon_sample.jpg') AS thumbnailUrl FROM carbon_products cp JOIN projects pj ON cp.project_id = pj.project_id LEFT JOIN farms f ON pj.farm_id = f.farm_id WHERE cp.cp_id = #{cpId}
SELECT discount_rate_pct FROM reduction_sale_policy WHERE #{sharePercent} >= min_ratio_pct AND #{sharePercent} < max_ratio_pct
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO carbon_hists (user_id, cp_id, amount, discounted_price, discount_rate, date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{cpId}, #{amount}, #{discountedPrice}, #{discountRate}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT snapshot_id FROM carbon_discount_snapshot_events WHERE status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY snapshot_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT snapshot_id, user_id, wallet_id, token_id, token_balance, total_supply, share_percent FROM carbon_snapshot_history WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND token_id = #{tokenId} LIMIT 1
SELECT snapshot_id, season_ym, planned_at, snapshot_at, status FROM carbon_discount_snapshot_events WHERE status = 'PLANNED' AND planned_at <= #{now} ORDER BY planned_at ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE carbon_discount_snapshot_events SET status = #{status}, snapshot_at = #{snapshotAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE snapshot_id = #{snapshotId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE role = 'ENTERPRISE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO carbon_snapshot_history ( snapshot_id, user_id, wallet_id, token_id, token_balance, total_supply, share_percent, created_at ) VALUES ( #{snapshotId}, #{userId}, #{walletId}, #{tokenId}, #{tokenBalance}, #{totalSupply}, #{sharePercent}, NOW() )
